'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Anglophone Crisis]]
**Ten people are killed and two others are injured as gunmen [[Mass shooting|open fire]] at a busy junction in [[Bamenda]], [[Northwest Region (Cameroon)| Northwest Region]], [[Cameroon]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/gunmen-kill-10-restive-northwest-cameroon-2023-07-17/ (Reuters)]
*[[Transnistria]]n [[Pridnestrovie Communist Party|communist]] and opposition leader [[Oleg Khorzhan]] is [[Assassination|assassinated]] during a [[stabbing attack]] in his office. [https://www.newsweek.com/oleg-khorzhan-communist-party-leader-transnistria-dead-1813420?amp=1 (''Newsweek'')]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Corporate responses to the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Russian President]] [[Vladimir Putin]] authorizes a temporary [[Government of Russia|state]] [[takeover]] of French [[agribusiness]] [[Danone]] and [[Carlsberg Group|Carlsberg]]-owned [[Brewery|brewer]] [[Baltika Breweries|Baltika]]'s [[Share (finance)|shares]], as part of a wider response to many private companies, including these two, reducing their business operations in [[Russia]] amid the [[Russo-Ukrainian War|ongoing war in Ukraine]]. [https://www.scmp.com/news/world/russia-central-asia/article/3227919/putin-signs-decree-russia-seize-shares-carlsberg-and-danone-subsidiaries (AFP via ''SCMP'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[List of earthquakes in 2023]]
**A 7.2 magnitude earthquake strikes off the coast of [[Alaska]], [[United States]], causing a [[tsunami warning]] to be issued for the region. [https://abcnews.go.com/US/tsunami-warning-issued-after-74-magnitude-earthquake-alaska/story?id=101319298 (ABC News)]
*Forty-two [[pilot whale]]s die in a mass [[Cetacean stranding|beaching]] incident on a beach in [[North Tolsta]], [[Outer Hebrides]], [[Scotland]], [[United Kingdom]], while 12 others are [[Animal euthanasia|euthanised]] following failed attempts to refloat them due to adverse conditions. [https://www.wionews.com/trending/over-50-pilot-whales-die-on-scottish-island-after-being-stranded-616325 (AFP via WION)]
*Six people are killed and three others are injured in a [[car crash]] in [[Tacoma, Washington|Tacoma]], [[Washington (State)|Washington]], [[United States]]. [https://apnews.com/article/car-accident-washington-tacoma-56be208800635a3019c62afb561eb179 (AP)]
*At least four people are killed and seven others are hospitalized when a [[water bus]] carrying 20 passengers [[capsizes]] in the [[Buriganga River]] near [[Dhaka]], [[Bangladesh]]. A rescue operation is ongoing. [https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/four-dead-in-bangladesh-as-boat-sinks-buriganga-river-101689530910198.html (Reuters via ''Hindustan Times'')]
*Four people are killed and 13 more injured during a [[Structural integrity and failure|building collapse]] in [[Beheira Governorate]], [[Egypt]]. [https://english.ahram.org.eg/News/504857.aspx (''Al-Ahram'')]
*The [[Office of Civil Defense (Philippines)|Office of Civil Defense]] in the [[Philippines]] reports that [[search and rescue]] operations are ongoing for nine passengers of a fishing vessel who went missing off [[Mercedes, Camarines Norte| Mercedes]], [[Camarines Norte]], earlier this week. [https://mb.com.ph/2023/7/16/9-fishermen-missing-in-camarines-norte (Philippine News Agency via ''Manila Bulletin'')]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[2023 Asia heat wave]]
**[[Japan]] issues [[heat stroke]] warnings in 20 of [[Prefectures of Japan|its prefectures]] due to near-record high temperatures, reaching nearly {{convert|40|C}} in some areas, with [[Japan Meteorological Agency|the country's meteorological agency]] indicating the possibility of surpassing the highest ever recorded temperature of {{convert|41.1|C}}. [https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/dangerous-heatwaves-strike-globe-as-wildfires-rage/article67087645.ece (AFP via ''The Hindu'')]
*At an [[Alzheimer's Association]] conference in [[Amsterdam]], [[Netherlands]], experts in [[Alzheimer's disease]] propose a new seven-point [[List of diagnostic classification and rating scales used in psychiatry|diagnostic scale]] that incorporates advancements in testing for key [[Biochemistry of Alzheimer's disease|Alzheimer's-related proteins]] and aims to facilitate more [[Personalized medicine|personalized treatment]] strategies. [https://www.reuters.com/business/healthcare-pharmaceuticals/alzheimers-diagnosis-revamp-embraces-rating-scale-similar-cancer-2023-07-16/ (Reuters)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Accession of the United Kingdom to CPTPP]]
**[[Secretary of State for Business and Trade|Business and Trade Secretary]] [[Kemi Badenoch]] formally signs the accession protocol for the [[United Kingdom]] to join the [[Comprehensive and Progressive Agreement for Trans-Pacific Partnership]]. [https://asia.nikkei.com/Economy/Trade/U.K.-formally-joins-CPTPP-to-little-fanfare-and-low-expectations (''Nikkei Asia'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Iranian protests against compulsory hijab]]
**Iranian [[Guidance Patrol|Morality Police]] resume patrols to enforce hijab compliance. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/7/16/irans-morality-police-return-as-authorities-enforce-hijab-rule (Al Jazeera)]
**A large protest occurs in the city of [[Rasht]] in response to the Morality Police's unsuccessful attempt to arrest three unveiled women. The crowd pushes the police back before security forces intervene with tear gas. [https://www.iranintl.com/en/202307165145 (Iran International)]
*Andre Longmore, the suspected gunman in a mass shooting in [[Hampton, Georgia|Hampton]], [[Georgia (U.S. state)|Georgia]], United States, is shot and killed by police, ending a manhunt for him. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/suspect-accused-killing-4-georgia-suburb-shot-dead-manhunt-rcna94554 (NBC News)]

'''Sports'''
*[[2023 ATP Tour]]
**[[2023 Wimbledon Championships]]
***In [[tennis]], [[Carlos Alcaraz]] of [[Spain]] defeats [[Novak Djokovic]] of [[Serbia]] in the final to win the [[2023 Wimbledon Championships – Men's singles|men's singles]] title at the 2023 [[Wimbledon Championships]], becoming the first non-[[Big Four (tennis)|Big Four]] player to win the tournament since [[2002 Wimbledon Championships – Men's singles|2002]]. [https://www.usatoday.com/story/sports/tennis/wimb/2023/07/16/novak-djokovic-carlos-alcaraz-wimbledon-mens-final-result/70417922007/ (''USA Today'')]
*[[2023 CONCACAF Gold Cup]]
**In [[association football]], [[Mexico national football team|Mexico]] win their ninth [[CONCACAF Gold Cup]] title after defeating [[Panama national football team|Panama]] 1–0 in the [[2023 CONCACAF Gold Cup final|final]] at [[SoFi Stadium]] in [[Inglewood, California|Inglewood]], [[California]], United States, with [[Santiago Giménez]] scoring the winner in the 88th minute. Panama's [[Adalberto Carrasquilla]] is awarded the tournament's [[Most valuable player|Golden Ball]]. [https://apnews.com/article/gold-cup-2023-mexico-panama-9146cb5825dd0e8a9c98e3c31b5e9eac (AP)]
